summary: Ansible 15 removed cyberark.pas (1.0.39) and netapp.cloudmanager (21.24.0), which can still be installed manually.
questions: Which collections were removed in Ansible 15?
How do I keep using cyberark.pas with Ansible 15?

answer_card.title: Collections removed in Ansible 15
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed from Ansible 15:

- cyberark.pas (was 1.0.39)
- netapp.cloudmanager (was 21.24.0)

Install manually if needed: `ansible-galaxy collection install <name-of-collection>`.
